title: 157. Design HashMap

examples.explanation: put(1,1) and put(2,2); get(1) is 1 and get(3) is -1. After put(2,1) updates key 2, get(2) is 1. After remove(2), get(2) is -1.
Initially get(5) is -1. After put(5,7), get(5) is 7. After remove(5), get(5) is -1.
No get calls, so the result is empty.

hints: Simulate the map with a hash map: put inserts or updates, remove deletes, get looks up with -1 default and records the result.
A direct array of size 1000001 with -1 sentinel also works since keys are bounded.
